title: Best of Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia and Bali
alt: Coral Island beach off Pattaya, Thailand
transport: Private transfers, city tours and guided day tours

stops.name: Pattaya
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel near Pattaya beach with a rooftop pool

activities.name: Coral Island day trip
activities.description: Speedboat out to Koh Larn for a day on the white sand at Tawaen beach, with water sports available on the beach at your own cost.

program.name: Pattaya
program.description: Two nights on the Gulf of Thailand to open the trip, with a speedboat day out to the white sand of Coral Island.

stops.name: Singapore
stops.subtitle: Singapore to Sentosa
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Albert Street hotel beside Bugis, close to two metro lines

activities.name: Night Safari with tram ride
activities.description: The world's first nocturnal zoo, with a tram ride through seven habitats and walking trails where the animals are at their most active.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The observation deck fifty seven floors above Marina Bay, with the city, the port and the Gardens by the Bay domes below you.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Entry to the Cloud Forest with its indoor waterfall, and the Supertree light show in the evening a short walk away.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A full day ticket for the Sentosa theme park, with seven themed zones, the duelling roller coasters and the street shows.

activities.name: Singapore city tour
activities.description: A half day tour past Merlion Park, the Marina Bay waterfront, Chinatown and the colonial quarter, with a guide on a shared coach.

program.name: Singapore
program.description: Four nights in the city with a night safari, the Marina Bay SkyPark, Gardens by the Bay, a full day at Universal Studios and a guided city tour.

stops.name: Kuala Lumpur
stops.subtitle: Kuala Lumpur to Genting Highlands
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Bukit Bintang hotel close to the food streets and the monorail

activities.name: Kuala Lumpur half day city tour
activities.match: Kuala Lumpur Half Day City Tour
activities.description: The King's palace gates, the National Monument, Merdeka Square and the old railway station, with a photo stop at the towers.

activities.name: Batu Caves
activities.description: The golden Murugan statue and the two hundred and seventy two painted steps up to the limestone cave temples above the city.

activities.name: Awana SkyWay cable car
activities.description: The glass fronted cable car up the hillside to Genting, with the rainforest canopy and the Chin Swee temple below you.

activities.name: Genting Highlands day trip
activities.description: The hill resort at eighteen hundred metres, with its indoor theme park, shopping floors and cool mountain air all afternoon.

program.name: Kuala Lumpur
program.description: Two nights in Bukit Bintang, with a city tour on arrival and a full hill day taking in Batu Caves and Genting by cable car.

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden resort a short walk from the Ubud market

activities.name: Kintamani and rice terrace day tour
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights in Bali to finish, with a coffee plantation day up to the Kintamani crater and the rice terraces at Tegalalang.

Water sports on the beach at your own cost

Evening tram ride at the Singapore Night Safari

The Supertree light show after dark

Awana SkyWay cable car up to Genting Highlands

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Four countries in eleven days sounds like a lot, but the hops are all under three hours. Nothing feels rushed.
expert.tip: Take the morning service on each hop and you keep every afternoon. Pack one small bag you can live out of, because you change hotels four times and the full cases stay packed.

summary: Eleven days and four countries: Coral Island from Pattaya, four nights in Singapore for the night safari, Marina Bay and Universal Studios, Kuala Lumpur for Batu Caves and Genting, then Bali for Kintamani and the rice terraces.
included: Included: 10 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and city transfers; Coral Island day trip; Night Safari; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; Gardens by the Bay; Universal Studios; Singapore city tour; Kuala Lumpur city tour; Batu Caves; Awana SkyWay and Genting day trip; Kintamani and rice terrace tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Bangkok to Singapore, Singapore to Kuala Lumpur and Kuala Lumpur to Denpasar flights, which we can add; visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
